record.title: Berserk
record.description:
From Dark Horse:  
His name is Guts, the Black Swordsman, a feared warrior spoken of only in whispers. Bearer of a gigantic sword, an iron hand, and the scars of countless battles and tortures, his flesh is also indelibly marked with The Brand, an unholy symbol that draws the forces of darkness to him and dooms him as their sacrifice. But Guts won't take his fate lying down; he'll cut a crimson swath of carnage through the ranks of the damned and anyone else foolish enough to oppose him! Accompanied by Puck the Elf, more an annoyance than a companion, Guts relentlessly follows a dark, bloodstained path that leads only to death or vengeance.

**Warning:** For mature audiences only, since it has sexual content and graphic violence (gore, rape, etc). 

The scanlated Episode 83 *God of the Abyss (2)* was published in Young Animal No. 14 in 1996 but is left out of all collected editions. Vol 14 includes *Berserk: The Prototype* (1988). 

Note: The 1988 Prototype chapter won a prize at the Comi Manga School Miura attended. Nominated for the Tezuka Osamu Award from 1998 to 2001 and won the Award for Excellence in 2002. Won the prize for Best Seinen Manga at the Japan Expo Awards in 2007, the Manga Barcelona award in the Seinen Category in 2013 and 2021. Berserk Deluxe Edition Vol 14 (Dark Horse) was nominated for the Harvey Award for Best Manga in 2024.

record.title: Berserk Princess
record.description:
Under the guise of marriage, Cheryn returns to the imperial capital to set her revenge plan in motion. However, she soon discovers that her fiancé, whom she has been betrothed to since childhood, is having an affair with her sister, Leila. Seizing this opportunity, Cheryn unilaterally breaks off their engagement, claiming she is searching for a new marriage partner. In doing so, she reaches out to the young heirs of Great Clans, aiming to use them in her schemes. Along the way, she gets emotionally entangled with the sons of these influential ministers, further complicating her plans.

**Original Manhua:**  
[AC.QQ](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/comicInfo/id/654240), [BiliBili](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc36395), [KuaiKan](https://www.kuaikanmanhua.com/web/topic/19066)

**Official Translations:**  
[English](https://www.webnovel.com/comic/berserk-princess_34670830908729201), [Japanese](https://manga.line.me/product/periodic?id=Z0003277)

*The English translation of [INKR Comics](https://comics.inkr.com/title/4787-berserk-princess) only translated up to ch.20.*

record.title: Berserk Gaiden
record.description:
A joke comic that mostly gives insight into the 1997 anime production and Miuras' life. The main characters are Miura and Puck, who is mainly there mainly to mess with Miura.

The Chapters and where they were published:  
1. 「ベルセルク外伝　真夜中の聖戦 」Young Animal Issue 24 1997  
2. 「ベルセルク外伝２　奪われしパンドラの箱」 Young Animal Berserk Special Blitzkrieg Issue, May 5, 1998  
3. 「ベルセルク外伝３　南海奇行ネオマンガ」Berserk Side Story 3 South Sea Eccentric Neo Manga | October 1998 / Berselk OFFICIAL SITE/shockwave or jpeg/15 | Link to the chapter is at the bottom of this blog entry from Miura [but it's contents is now lost media](https://web.archive.org/web/19991104215944/http://www.hakusensha.co.jp/berserk/ken_diary02.html)  
4. 「ベルセルク外伝４　電脳ジャッカー」 "Berserk Sword Wind Chronicles Complete Analysis Book", December 9, 1998 (Anime art book)

Kentarou Miura's 4 Koma GAG Festival chapters:

6. 『因果だほい』Young Animal Issue 1 1998 (along with Chap 112)  
7. 『ザ グレート インパクト キャット』 Young Animal Issue 10 1999 (along with Chap 141)

record.title: Bousou Honnou Melancholia
record.description:
From AQUA Scans: 

Cornered by delinquents, Katanabe Shino was just waiting for her end...  until Tachibana-kun, her bad-tempered classmate, saves her. She then decides to give him a not so chaste "thank you gift".

record.title: Berserk Official Guidebook
record.description:
From Dark Horse:  
Berserk has conquered the worlds of manga and anime, and now comes the essential roadmap to the sprawling Berserk universe, exploring the characters, creatures, settings, and stories of Berserk's first 38 volumes.  
Profusely illustrated and including never-before-seen art (including an eight-page color section) and author notes by Kentaro Miura, the Official Guidebook is a comprehensive tour through the epic adventure, shocking horror, and graveyard humor that can be only Berserk.
